narrative.overview: Raíces Personalizaciones speaks the language of craft and purpose. Every surface feels like stepping into a well-organized atelier — where materials are chosen intentionally, tools are at hand, and each piece carries meaning. The visual identity balances raw energy (bold gradients, punchy typography) with considered sophistication (clean grids, precise spacing, restrained color application).
keyCharacteristics: Bold, uppercase display typography for impact
Vibrant gradient accents for key moments
Generous spacing for visual breathing room

rules.name: The Yellow Rule
rules.body: Brand Yellow appears on ≤15% of any given screen. Its rarity creates impact — every yellow element earns attention.

rules.name: The Gradient Gradient Rule
rules.body: The cyan → pink → yellow gradient appears only in announcement bars and hero decorative elements. It signals energy in motion, never readable text backgrounds.

rules.name: The Script Rule
rules.body: Permanent Marker and Caveat appear on ≤3 elements per screen. They are signature moments, not working type.

rules.name: The Glow Rule
rules.body: Colored glows appear only on hover/focus states, never at rest. They signal interactivity, not decoration.

dos: Do let yellow carry the primary action
Do use tonal layering for depth rather than heavy drop shadows
Do keep script fonts to 2-3 elements per screen maximum
Do pair bold headings with generous breathing room
donts: Don't use the gradient as a text background or button fill
Don't apply colored glows to elements at rest
Don't mix Permanent Marker and Caveat in the same visual area
Don't use more than one accent color per component group
Don't set body text smaller than 0.875rem
